_doc: Fixture of the block graph pairing test (P1-009, tools/bake/graph/pilot_graph.test.mjs). divided: streets of the pilot centre drawn in OSM as two one-way carriageways; each must be found as a pair with both edges within 40 m of the probe point (lat, lon). name is the street; osmName, when given, is a name one of the two edges carries in OSM (Mathura Road along Pragati Maidan has no name tag there, so it is found by place alone). oneWay: true one-way streets that must stay unpaired (the Connaught Place radials, DELHI_WORLD.md hero roads; knowledge world-and-map: R-ROAD-04 flags them, never auto). Probe points were read from the graph of 2026-11-11 (osmBase 2026-11-11T15:09:21Z) at the middle of the longest pair and checked against the street names.

divided.name: Mathura Road
divided.where: along Pragati Maidan, both halves unnamed in OSM
